name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.9.2 — Hotfix: viewport scroll for outcome dialog. In v1.9.1 the sprint outcome dialog at 'Finish sprint' opened correctly in DOM but in some YouTrack iframe layouts landed outside the visible parent viewport, so users perceived 'nothing happened'. The dialog is now opened via the shared `_showOverlay()` helper used by every other modal in the plugin — same iframe-scroll handling, same z-index stacking. Pure runtime fix; no schema changes; 221 unit tests pass. Includes all of v1.9.1 (outcome dialog moved to Finish sprint) and v1.9.0 (Sprint goals + Stand-up assist). See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
